trackTitle: CBSE Class XI Computer Science (Subject Code: 083) Complete Mastery
description: An exhaustive, exam-aligned master curriculum for CBSE Class XI Computer Science (Code 083) as prescribed by CBSE (2024-25 / 2025-26). Covers Unit I: Computer Systems and Organisation (10 Marks), Unit II: Computational Thinking and Programming - 1 (45 Marks) including explicit l-value/r-value mechanics, syntax/logical/runtime errors, strings, lists, tuples, dictionaries, and modules, Unit III: Society, Law and Ethics (15 Marks) featuring dedicated Technology & Society coverage (gender & disability inclusion, assistive technology), clearly demarcated Enrichment modules (AI, IoT, Cloud, Blockchain, signed binary 2's complement), and a complete 20-program Practical Laboratory Repository with Suggested Mock Examination Papers.
